text:
Sam: Quick sync — TeleWell POC kickoff. Need to align scope + success criteria. Key ask from buyer: realtime summarization, patient triage suggestions, and embedding search over prior notes. They care about HIPAA, latency <300ms for short prompts, and deterministic outputs for triage logic. Can SRE/SE weigh in on feasibility and set of endpoints to expose?

Maria: Suggest starting with two flows: 1) Summarization pipeline for visit notes (batch) using embeddings for search, 2) Real-time chat assistant for triage with tool-calling to fetch patient meds. Prioritize Summarization first. Proposed endpoints: `POST /v1/generate`, `POST /v1/embeddings/search`, `POST /v1/chat/stream` with function-calling. Sample prompt:
```
system: You are a clinical summarizer. Produce SOAP-format summaries from Visit notes.
user: Visit notes: {{text}}
```
I will prepare eval prompts.

Jordan: Success criteria idea: (a) Summaries meet avg ROUGE-L >= 0.6 vs human baseline, (b) triage suggestions agree with clinician label >=90% on 200 eval prompts, (c) median response latency 250ms for 16-token responses under dedicated capacity. Timeline: 4-week POC: week1 data ingestion & quickstart; week2 models + quantization; week3 integrations & evals; week4 review + handoff.

Evan: HIPAA note: we'll need BAA signed, VPC private deployment preferred, KMS for keys, audit logs, and data retention policy. TeleWell asked for SOC2 + pentest. Flag: embedded PHI in eval prompts — need redaction. I'll send checklist.

Sam: Pricing Q from buyer: estimate for 4-week POC with dedicated small pool (2x A100 equiv): can we produce a ballpark? Also they asked about cost per 1k summaries and embeddings ops. @maria / @jordan thoughts?

Maria: Ballpark: reserved 2-GPU pool ~$15k/month prorated ~$3.75k for 4 weeks + egress + eval compute. Per-summary cost ~ $0.02 (depends on tokens), embedding search per doc ~ $0.005. I'll put detailed estimate in the doc.

Jordan: Enterprise blocker: legal wants data residency in us-east only. Also require SSO & SCIM before production. Can we scope POC without SCIM? propose POC use temporary SAML stub + user mapping.

Sam: TeleWell stakeholder reply (copied): "We can provide de-identified dataset for evals but need on-prem option if pilot goes well." — keeping them engaged.

Maria: I'll draft prompts and a small eval harness (200 cases) and share as gist. Also propose canned fallback model for availability: "gpt-like-small" fallback. Code snippet for chat call with function-calling:
```
fetch('/v1/chat/stream',{
  method:'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({
    messages:[{role:'system',content:'You are a triage assistant...'}],
    functions:[{name:'get_medications',parameters:{type:'object'}}]
  })
})
```

Evan: I uploaded security checklist to drive and added redaction library recommendation (pii-scrubber v0.9). Also propose isolated VPC peering for data ingress.

Sam: OK, action items: Maria — eval prompts + estimate by Tue; Evan — send security checklist + BAA template; Jordan — updated success criteria doc + timeline; Sam — schedule kickoff with TeleWell for Thursday 11am PT. @deploybot scheduled meeting.

deploybot: Calendar invite sent to telewell@telewell.co for Thu 11:00 AM PT

telewell_pm: Thanks team — that timeline works. We'll surface de-identified sample by Monday.
